status: registered before new same-cohort baseline calculations; existing LLM outcomes already inspected

frozen_llm.note: requested alias/temperature equality alone cannot rule out backend-version drift

baseline_rule: copy_previous uses own exact calendar t-1 frozen Q9 mean; history_anchor_half = previous + 0.50*(mean of strictly earlier valid frozen Q9 means - previous); fewer than two histories falls back to copy_previous. No current nationwide level or current answer enters either prediction.
coefficient_origin: fixed candidate borrowed from Kimi C1 training result; Kimi trained on official means with a current-truth common shift. This past-only, frozen-score variant is not the identical C1 estimator and is not fitted on this cohort.
history_policy: all strictly earlier legal, scorable raw Q9 questionnaires of the same respondent, unweighted; never current/future answers or weights
q8_policy: Q8 direct signed points evaluated separately; copy_previous available; no automatic transfer of the Q9 historical-anchor coefficient to Q8
quantiles: left-inverse empirical CDF for Q9 and Q8; interpolated IQR auxiliary only; old published Q8 interpolation remains historical, not overwritten
weighting: unweighted selected cohorts, month x repeat cells equally weighted; not a nationally representative headline
common_sample: within each measure, real and exact previous values and ALL registered conditions must be valid; report full-roster failures separately; Q8 and Q9 samples need not match; new conditions may shrink common sample and this is explicitly reported

bootstrap.unit: whole respondent across fixed months and both repeats; paired across all conditions; repeats are not independent people; discard and count draws empty in any cell
bootstrap.scope: conditional on these four selected months, fixed histories and saved responses; not a national or future-month confidence interval

contrasts: each LLM condition vs copy_previous and history_anchor_half, plus own_previous vs no_prior and permuted_previous; future condition vs own_previous and both past-only baselines

decision_rules.execution: registered inputs, complete expected roster, current/future isolation, scorer hashes and separate failure counts required; no new API initiated by evaluation
decision_rules.pilot_signal: candidate vs frozen U0 own_previous: center MAE and cross-section W1 lower, delta W1 no higher, in EACH of two repeats; candidate Q9 scoring coverage no lower. This is a project screening convention, not proof or an academic standard.
decision_rules.baseline_increment: report all three metric differences against BOTH past-only baselines; no selecting an easier baseline after results. Improvement over U0 alone is not improvement over simple methods.
decision_rules.conditional_support: paired whole-person intervals for the three main differences vs U0 and baselines; intervals containing zero mean direction not resolved in this conditional sample, not a zero effect
decision_rules.formal_adoption: none from this reused four-month cohort; independent months and larger representative cohorts, including Route B availability and recursive state, still required
decision_rules.failure: no effect, center-only improvement, or distribution/updates worsening all retained as distinct outcomes; no variance inflation or headline blending counted as raw simulation success

unavailable_comparisons: Kimi oracle-common-shift C1 and long-span nationwide baselines remain separate conditional/reference studies; no direct ranking against this 12-person cohort
future_import: new JSONL keyed by registered month/agent_id/repeat/arm; q8_point_pct and q9_probabilities, plus hashed manifest with months/repeats/arms/model/temperature/run_ids; same registered roster, no guessing cross-run person IDs
